## Installation

Install GraftQL with pip:

```bash
pip install graftql
```

Or with uv:

```bash
uv add graftql
```

## Quick Start

Create a project directory and a virtual environment:

```bash
mkdir graftql-tutorial
cd graftql-tutorial
python -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate  # on Windows: .venv\Scripts\activate
pip install graftql
```
